title: Absence Deduction Rules — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: A named scale for reducing sick leave pay as sick days add up within a cycle. The steps are its details; the scale is attached to a sub group's sick leave entitlement.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: RuleName
fields.html:
What it is. The name of the scale. It has one name only.

Example. Kuwait Sick Leave Scale
